data.one_liner: Programmatically control device orientation on iOS, Android, and Web.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to programmatically switch between portrait, landscape, and auto rotation modes on iOS, Android, and Web. It includes helper getters for checking orientation and a declarative AutoOrientationScope widget for automatic locking and reverting.
use_when: You are building a video player that needs to switch to landscape in fullscreen.
You are creating a game or reading app requiring specific forced orientations.
avoid_when: You prefer manually invoking SystemChrome.setPreferredOrientations exclusively.
strengths: Supports forceSensor on Android to override user rotation settings.
Includes orientation helper getters like isLandscape and isPortrait.
weaknesses: Some portrait down modes may not function properly on all devices.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package. Do not manually call SystemChrome.setPreferredOrientations.
